scope: opt-in local workload and management TLS leaf keys; CA and delegated JWK signing keys excluded
publication: immutable generation pairs; overlap pins; atomic profile/config switches; reload ack and live TLS; retire pins; self-revoke old client serials; grace then unlink old files
limits: trusted single control plane with access to selected leaf keys; not independent workload attestation
no CA root/intermediate or delegated signing authority key rotation, HSM, HA, production deployment
unlink is not guaranteed physical erasure; process memory, open descriptors and backups are outside this guarantee
not a distributed transaction or zero-downtime SLA; stale profile readers fail closed after cleanup
passive revocation does not terminate existing sessions; native Go/NGINX CA/SAN paths have no exact client leaf pin
no new paid API or cloud use; existing unrelated Docker work is preserved
